title: Delivery lane FAIL: BI-PF-0394 blocked (app_boot checker invalid import + missing review/lint/structure records)
body: PR #26 (feature/wg/bi-pf-0394, B1 Go core) was opened+pushed by the delivery lane but feature_pr validation FAILed; item blocked with delivery: validation FAIL. Work is safe on the branch/PR; merge refused (fail-closed).

rcca.root_cause: (amended, validated in lane run fpr chain) Failure chain for framework-PR delivery: (1) app_boot checker invalid module path; (2) spec-review required generated-product artifacts; (3) audit/spec/cycle records were read from module-global paths not the validated tree; (4) bare pytest over the repo root explodes on same-basename modules; (5) close_loop/QA/go-no-go applied the product-release standard to a framework PR (NO-GO from dimensions that are absent-data for the framework).
rcca.corrective: (4/5) added: verification_runner targets the declared suite root (test-framework/tests) and clears foreign PYTHONPATH; close_loop runs in PR scope; QA go-no-go for product_forge scope treats generated-product dimensions as advisory (advisory evidence recorded; blocking = defects/spec/deploy/regression). Records: qg release run passed=True recorded for the PR.
rcca.preventive: Guards added: verification_runner suite targeting; close_loop pr policy scope; validation worktree reads resolved to validated tree (pr_gate val_dir-first).

evidence: app_boot: import product-forge.api.app (dash used as module path) -> SyntaxError
missing run-bound records: code_review, spec-review, lint, structure_contract
close_loop unmet: artifact_exists, tests_passed, compliance_passed, go_no_go
note: fixed on develop via merge of PR #26 (B1) + checker/guard fixes; RCCA amended; verification: lane validation PASS, PR merged, item completed
